name: Dislocation
description: Teleports to one of this unit's own pylons and consumes it, cutting every ability cooldown by 1 turn and granting a %barrier_hp% health barrier for %barrier_duration% turns.
details: A pylon sharing its tile with another unit cannot be used.

upgrade.summary: The pylon survives, taking %pylon_damage% damage instead of being consumed.
upgrade.description: Teleports to one of this unit's own pylons and draws %pylon_damage% damage out of it, cutting every ability cooldown by 1 turn and granting a %barrier_hp% health barrier for %barrier_duration% turns.
details: A pylon sharing its tile with another unit cannot be used.
The pylon detonates as though it had died - stunning and damaging adjacent enemies - even when the %pylon_damage% leaves it standing.
A pylon that was already hurt can still be spent outright, dying to the draw as it always did.
